questions.explanation:
## Correct Answer
Update the Application's destination cluster to the correct cluster.

## Why Other Options Are Wrong
- Option B is incorrect because the repo URL does not address the mis-targeted cluster; the resources exist in the wrong cluster context, not the wrong repository.
- Option C is possible but disruptive and does not fix the root cause; it also loses linkage to the original history.
- Option D does not address the misconfiguration of the destination cluster and would not resolve the Missing status.

## Key Concepts
- Argo CD Application spec.destination
- Kubernetes cluster contexts and cluster registration in Argo CD
- Health status semantics (Missing vs Synced vs Degraded)

## Real-World Application
- When an application is targeted at a cluster you no longer manage, update spec.destination.server to the correct cluster, ensure the cluster is registered in Argo CD, then re-sync. This minimizes downtime and preserves history.
